html:
SMTO-WEB-0007 — Only part of the web page arrived

GUID: e573a0bf-90e8-44c9-aae4-de37f1a68059
Slug: web-response-incomplete
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web

What happened

  • SMTO started downloading the page or document, but the connection ended before all of it arrived. SMTO didn't use the partial copy as if it were complete.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the conversation, ask SMTO to read the same address again. Reading a page only looks at it, so trying again is safe, and a brief network hiccup often clears.
  2. Check that the computer running SMTO has a steady internet connection, for example that other websites load normally. An unstable connection can drop a download partway through.
  3. If it fails again for the same address, ask SMTO to use a different source for the same information. Some sites cut off large pages or files, so a second source may be the only way to get complete content.

What success looks like

  • SMTO reads the page without this message and uses its content in the answer.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the address, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't rely on anything SMTO says came from this page until it has been read in full.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Web read or document download ended before the declared Content-Length was received or before the compressed stream reached its end.

What this means

  • Response reading reaches EOF before the advertised body ends or before compressed data reaches its end marker. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • Response reading reaches EOF before the advertised body ends or before compressed data reaches its end marker.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the body-completion flag, declared length and compression state in the retained outcome.

How to fix it

  • read_body in src/agent_runtime/skills/web/transport.py and documents.acquire.chunks raise response_incomplete on EOF with remaining declared length or an unfinished gzip/deflate stream. Retry the bounded read (it is read-only) and check network stability or proxies between the Server and the site; if the origin keeps truncating, use another authoritative source.
  • Request a fresh bounded read or use an alternative authoritative source.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A new authorized read records a complete bounded response before its contents support claims.

What not to do

  • Do not present a partial response as the complete page or an exhaustive result.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
